answer: Bind each identity to a single operator's scarce attention. At unpredictable moments through the epoch, every identity must judge a fresh claim in context — a prism turned on that hour's work, never a reusable script. One agent handles a handful easily; a farm facing an ocean of simultaneous prompts cannot. Its puppets answer late, generically, or in identical words, and each late or copied marble cast earns nothing. Multiplying identities then only multiplies missed windows.
